purpose.domain_detail: French payroll system - periodic recapitulation of salary codes (codes salaire) per employee, generating a CSV/delimited export file
purpose.summary: Program 8-CSMUL produces a periodic summary report of salary codes (codes salaire) for employees. It reads a payroll file (CODPAIE), filters by firm, employee, and month range, matches against configured salary code parameters, and writes a delimited output file (TF-CSM) with employee details and salary code values. It supports multilingual output (French, German, English) for column headers.
